limitations: Four known diagnostic cases; two repeats of the same frozen circuits, not independent problem samples.
Exact 95% binomial intervals assume independent shots; correlations and drift remain unidentified.
1000 multinomial replicates, seed515151: histogram-TV reference only; no state fidelity or multiple-testing inference.
Device noise approximates calibration; idle, crosstalk and drift remain incompletely modelled.
Technical M5 PASS does not establish exact noise-model validity, general Warm-Start superiority or Quantum Advantage.
